verdict.rationale: Manufact's MCP server and CLI expose most platform management (orgs, servers, deployments, logs, observability, deploys, env vars) so AI-native users can programmatically replicate much of the dashboard UI (manufact-docs-14, -26, -31), and API keys enable REST/CI access (manufact-docs-17). However, an OpenAPI/REST spec could not be located (manufact-probe-2 returned 404 on all candidate paths), and there's no evidence that UI-only features like billing spend limits, publish-checklist configuration, or branch/production settings are exposed programmatically. Missing for 10: a documented REST API reference or OpenAPI spec, and confirmation that billing/checklist/branch-settings UI actions have API/MCP equivalents.
